description: This file contains the definition of the class EntryPointConfirmOptInHandler, which handles email opt-in confirmation requests, processes them, and generates appropriate responses.

classes.name: EntryPointConfirmOptInHandler
classes.description: Handles email opt-in confirmation process, including user confirmation and sending opt-in emails.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes handler, determines method to call based on request, and outputs result.

methods.name: callMethod
methods.description: Dispatches the request to appropriate handler method based on the 'method' parameter.

methods.name: methodConfirmOptInSelected
methods.description: Handles batch confirmation of selected opt-in email addresses.

methods.name: methodConfirmOptInUser
methods.description: Handles individual email address confirmation using a token.

methods.name: getIDs
methods.description: Retrieves related IDs for email address in given module.

methods.name: setLawfulBasisForEachPerson
methods.description: Sets lawful basis for each person record related to an email address.
